tasks.subject: Task 1: Add selectedTreatmentIds filter to ExportService
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make ExportService::generate() accept an optional list of treatment IDs so only selected data is exported.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/Services/ExportService.php`
- Test: `tests/Feature/ExportServiceTest.php`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] generate() with empty $selectedTreatmentIds produces identical output to the current behaviour
- [ ] generate(['1','2']) only includes treatments with those IDs, their profiles, posology history, and calendar events
- [ ] Profiles with no selected treatments are excluded from the export
- [ ] Settings are always exported in full regardless of filter

**Verify:** `php artisan test tests/Feature/ExportServiceTest.php` → all green

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/Services/ExportService.php", "tests/Feature/ExportServiceTest.php"], "verifyCommand": "php artisan test tests/Feature/ExportServiceTest.php", "acceptanceCriteria": ["generate() with empty filter exports all data", "generate() with filter exports only selected treatments and their profiles/history/events", "Profiles with no selected treatments are excluded", "Settings always exported in full"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Create the Export Livewire component
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Build the /export page with profile/treatment selection, cascade logic, and the export action.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Livewire/Export.php`
- Create: `resources/views/livewire/export.blade.php`
- Modify: `routes/web.php`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Livewire/ExportTest.php`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Page loads and shows all active (non-archived) profiles with their treatments, all pre-selected
- [ ] Archived profiles are not shown
- [ ] Toggling a profile selects/deselects all its treatments
- [ ] Toggling a treatment recomputes the parent profile checked state
- [ ] Export button shows 'Exporter (N traitements)' and is disabled when 0 selected
- [ ] Summary header shows correct reactive counts
- [ ] export() calls ExportService::generateEncrypted() with correct treatment IDs

**Verify:** `php artisan test tests/Feature/Livewire/ExportTest.php` → all green

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/Livewire/Export.php", "resources/views/livewire/export.blade.php", "routes/web.php", "tests/Feature/Livewire/ExportTest.php"], "verifyCommand": "php artisan test tests/Feature/Livewire/ExportTest.php", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Page loads showing active profiles + treatments all pre-selected", "Archived profiles not shown", "Toggle profile cascades to treatments", "Toggle treatment recomputes profile state", "Export button disabled when 0 treatments", "Successful export redirects to home with flash"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Update Dashboard — replace export button with navigation to /export
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The Dashboard export icon navigates to /export instead of triggering export directly. On return, display the export_success flash message.

**Files:**
- Modify: `resources/views/livewire/dashboard.blade.php`
- Modify: `app/Livewire/Dashboard.php`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Export icon navigates to /export with wire:navigate
- [ ] export() method and related properties removed from Dashboard.php
- [ ] Dashboard shows success banner when session('export_success') is set
- [ ] No regression on existing dashboard rendering

**Verify:** `php artisan test` → full suite green

```json:metadata
{"files": ["resources/views/livewire/dashboard.blade.php", "app/Livewire/Dashboard.php"], "verifyCommand": "php artisan test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Export icon is a link to /export", "Dashboard.php has no export() method", "Flash banner displayed when export_success session key set", "Full test suite passes"]}
```
